plain_english: Homage to Soma master — his longing drawn in, desire stretched long, the moon his crest.
sanskrit_cite: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ

plain_english: Crying 'incapable, what can I do?' with nowhere a resolve to stand on — Śaṅkara's grace that befriends all is where I hide.
sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

plain_english: You stand past the strands, yourself proclaimed sheer wonder — in what corner, Bhava, could a second you be found?
sanskrit_cite: guṇātītasya nirdiṣṭaniḥśeṣātiśayātmanaḥ labhyate bhava kutrāṃśe paraḥ pratinidhis tava

plain_english: Nondual you are, boundless self, O lord — and still your fathomless glamour fools us now.
sanskrit_cite: nirdvandve nirupādhau ca tvayy ātmani sati prabho vayaṃ vañcyāmahe 'dyāpi māyayāmeyayā tava

plain_english: Powers from the minute on, undying lordship, becoming's end — Bhava, these are green shoots of the prayer-tree rooted in you.
sanskrit_cite: aṇimādiguṇāvāptiḥ sadaiśvaryaṃ bhavakṣayaḥ amī bhava bhavadbhaktikalpapādapapallavāḥ

plain_english: No direction lacks you; all hours are your stuff — won already, yet when, lord, shall I win you? Speak.
sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām

plain_english: Homage, Śambhu — lone tenant of lucid honest hearts, ash-white limbs, high swan.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ prasannasadvṛttamānasaikanivāsine bhūribhūtisitāṅgāya mahāhaṃsāya śambhave

plain_english: Scatter the surging gloom, burn every stick of becoming — be my lamp of waking, lord, my lamp of love.
sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā

plain_english: You set the triple-world drama teeming with live seed — Hara, to strike the set, what playwright but you has skill?
sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭānekasadbījagarbhaṃ trailokyanāṭakam prastāvya hara saṃhartuṃ tvattaḥ ko 'nyaḥ kaviḥ kṣamaḥ

plain_english: Homage to turn the real and the fake to nought or to aught — to the bound and the free, who wears wasting and sway as one.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ sadasatāṃ kartum asattvaṃ sattvam eva vā svatantrāyāsvatantrāya vyayaiśvaryaikaśāline

plain_english: Any joy glimpsed here in all three worlds — a droplet of whom? To that sea-of-bliss god I bend.
sanskrit_cite: trailokye 'py atra yo yāvān ānandaḥ kaścid īkṣyate sa bindur yasya taṃ vande devam ānandasāgaram

plain_english: Ah, lucky Brahmā and the rest — dropped all chatter, drunk with delight they mumble: Śiva, hail, hail.
sanskrit_cite: aho brahmādayo dhanyā ye vimuktānyasaṃkatham namo namaḥ śivāyeti japanty āhlādavihvalāḥ

plain_english: Hail the hungerless apportioner of hunger without end; though the world never began, its feaster — Bhava, take my bow.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkāmāyāpi kāmānām anantānāṃ vidhāyine anāditve 'pi viśvasya bhoktre bhava namo 'stu te

plain_english: The lord we laud, taproot of the triple world's start — who would beg a favour of the flawless?
sanskrit_cite: stumas tribhuvanārambhamūlaprakṛtim īśvaram lipseran nopakāraṃ ke yataḥ sampūrṇadharmaṇaḥ

plain_english: Sunk in dire straits, muddied by floods of folly — let him be recalled, and minds grow lucid: Śiva we sing.
sanskrit_cite: mahatsv apy arthakṛcchreṣu mohaughamalinīkṛtāḥ smṛte yasmin prasīdanti matayas taṃ śivaṃ stumaḥ

plain_english: Lord, from you only, unbroken sway holds here — at whose nod the three worlds fold and unfold.
sanskrit_cite: prabho bhavata eveha prabhuśaktir abhaṅgurā yadicchayā pratāyete trailokyasya layodayau

plain_english: Aim filth at him and it turns sterling; aim merit elsewhere — O, nowhere else such alchemy.
sanskrit_cite: kukarmāpi yam uddiśya devaṃ syāt sukṛtaṃ param sukṛtasyāpi saukṛtyaṃ yato 'nyatra na so 'si bhoḥ

plain_english: 'Caught in our fist, caught in our sight — where will you slip from us?' — so, drunk on love's sap, the lucky sprint for the Matted One.
sanskrit_cite: eṣa muṣṭyā gṛhīto 'si dṛṣṭa eṣa kva yāsi naḥ iti bhaktirasādhmātā dhanyā dhāvanti dhūrjaṭim

plain_english: You we laud — sung in verse, formula, chant, from light, from farther, farthest — your lore-body to be known — ah, sombre and fair.
sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

plain_english: Law and start and close of the world are you, high Lord — the host of duties marched out: unissued from you, whence could it march?
sanskrit_cite: vidhir ādis tathānto 'si viśvasya parameśvara dharmagrāmaḥ pravṛtto yas tvatto na sa kuto bhavet
